actions.item: Arrow Escape live-code puzzle generator level validation hardening
actions.before: Nonfinite or unbounded user-supplied levels could corrupt progression/seed calculations
actions.change: Validate finite numeric level and clamp to bounded integer, preserving deterministic puzzle generation; add nine malformed input regressions
actions.after: Engine and tests committed; Node CI verified 204 solvable levels plus 9 invalid and boundary input cases; no live game deployment
